# slugger

Turns titles into URL slugs.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

request: When you get a chance: Right now `slugify('Crème Brûlée')` returns `cr-me-br-l-e`. Make it transliterate accents to plain ASCII letters so you get `creme-brulee`. Add a test. Commit it when you're done. Cheers.
